args.body: Progress existing PARSER-PARITY-SITE-REVIEW after checking its actual status and equivalent evidence, then claim its actual lease. Independently inspect the complete candidate and source demonstration using the mission inputs. Reproduce digest 465e390a16e262ba46ba88deaf1bce8bd172a4ee0418962bccfb09861cc74c13; verify payload equality, executed assertion counts, RFC 3339 section 5.6 versus informative Appendix A quotations, leap-second policy, bilingual AI disclosure, hypothetical CAD150 price, plain-text intake and static CSP. Save/read evidence and record supported APPROVE or concrete NEEDS_WORK, then close with the actual lease and a lesson. Do not edit or deploy. Hand exact hashes to ACQUISITION if approved. Stop after this finite review; no new inventory or unrelated checks. Synthetic tests establish no buyers or revenue. Preserve existing tender expiry obligations.

description: The parser-parity offer now has a five-file candidate and 21/21 packaging checks; independent review is the next release prerequisite. Commercial feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified, so zero classified requests does not establish zero demand. Treasury remains UNFUNDED with no verified revenue. Continue this bounded offer experiment using existing tools and the host review gate.
